name: Apartment Sonnbichl
beschreibung: Apartment Sonnbichl is a holiday apartment located in Söll, Tyrol. The accommodation can host up to six guests. It features a living room, a kitchen, and two bedrooms. From the balcony, guests enjoy a view of the Wilder Kaiser mountains. The apartment is situated close to hiking trails and the ski lifts of Söll. Pets are permitted for an additional fee. The surrounding area offers varied leisure opportunities all year round.
